t.zh: 有的输出不止给一个框，而是给每个像素一个数：一张和照片一样大的图。0 是背景，其余的数是什么意思，要从图里读出来。
t.en: Some outputs give not a box but a number for every pixel: a map as large as the photo. 0 is background; what the other numbers mean has to be read from the map.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：「每个像素属于哪一类」和「每个像素属于哪一个物体」是同一个问题吗？对着每张图里的数，为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的那张。
t.en: This level asks: is 'which class does each pixel belong to' the same question as 'which object does each pixel belong to'? Reading the numbers in each map, give every question the map that is just enough to answer it.

after.zh: 给每个像素标出它属于哪一个物体，叫<wiki-ref to="instance-segmentation"></wiki-ref>；只标类别的是语义分割。
after.en: Labelling each pixel with the object it belongs to is <wiki-ref to="instance-segmentation"></wiki-ref>; labelling only the class is semantic segmentation.

brief.zh: 为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的那张逐像素图。
brief.en: For each question, choose the per-pixel map that is just enough to answer it.

hint.zh: 数一数每张图里出现了几种不为 0 的数，再看它们各占哪些格子。
hint.en: Count how many different non-zero numbers each map holds, and which cells each covers.

hint.zh: 一块连成片的区域不一定就是一个物体。
hint.en: One connected region is not necessarily one object.

prompt.zh: 图里有几只狗，每只占哪些像素？
prompt.en: How many dogs are there, and which pixels does each cover?

prompt.zh: 一根柱子挡在一只狗前面：图里一共有几只狗？
prompt.en: A post stands in front of one dog: how many dogs are there in all?

prompt.zh: 柱子以外，哪些像素是狗？
prompt.en: Apart from the post, which pixels are dog?

why.zh: 这张图只给每个像素标了类别：同一类的像素都是同一个数，挨着的两只狗连成一片，数不出有几只。
why.en: This map labels each pixel with its class only: every pixel of one class holds the same number, so two touching dogs merge into one region and cannot be counted.
